plan.notes: Official CSUDH Academic Catalog 2025-2026, Health Science B.S. program page, 'Health Care Management Option Roadmaps' 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid), Total Hours 120. All semester sums reconcile with printed Hours (15+16+15+12+15+17+18+12=120). Courses marked * in the source 'must be taken within that semester' per the roadmap footnote. Statistics requirement is a choice (MAT 131 / MAT 132 / MAT 134) at 3 units. 'HEA Elective (from list below)' references the roadmap footnote: HEA 316, HEA 465, HEA 495 (repeatable), HEA 320 (if BIO 102 completed). GE recommendations preserved in choice notes. ECO 210 satisfies GE 4A; HEA 468 satisfies GE 4UD; HEA 466 satisfies GE 5UD. HEA 496/497 require internship coordinator approval per source. The Radiologic Technology Option on this page is NOT collected: the source states it 'is not currently accepting new students,' so it is not genuinely offered. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.
